trello.name: Setup Stripe Subscription Tiers
trello.desc: Configure the three subscription tiers in Stripe: Basic ($29 per month, includes basic access to AI model selection tool and limited feature set), Pro ($49 per month, offers additional features and priority support), and Enterprise ($99 per month, includes all features, custom support, and integration options). Ensure these are set up correctly to be reflected in the app's functionality and user experience.

trello.name: Develop Frontend Checkout Process with Stripe Elements
trello.desc: Owner: Jordan. Deadline: Initial integration within 2 weeks. Use Stripe Elements to build the checkout process, ensuring the form matches the app's design and handles errors gracefully (e.g., invalid card details, insufficient funds). Update the pricing page to reflect the new tiers with a clear comparison of features for each plan, a prominent checkout button, and a tooltip or help icon explaining what happens if they choose a different plan later.

trello.name: Develop User Dashboard for Subscription Management
trello.desc: Owner: Jordan. Deadline: Initial integration within 2 weeks. Build the user dashboard to include current plan details and billing info, options to upgrade/downgrade/cancel subscriptions, access to invoices and payment history, and a way to update payment methods. The dashboard must be intuitive, reflect the current subscription status in real-time, and notify users of any changes such as successful plan upgrades or payment failures.

trello.name: Integrate Stripe Backend API for Subscriptions
trello.desc: Owner: Taylor. Deadline: Initial integration within 2 weeks. Integrate Stripe's API to handle all subscription-related tasks, including creating subscriptions when a user selects a plan and completes payment, and processing both successful and failed payments.

trello.name: Implement Stripe Webhook Handlers
trello.desc: Owner: Taylor. Deadline: Initial integration within 2 weeks. Set up and thoroughly test webhook handlers for specific events: `invoice.payment_succeeded` (confirm payments, activate/continue subscription), `invoice.payment_failed` (notify users to update payment info, consider sending an email notification), and `customer.subscription.deleted` (manage cancellations, update access rights, offer re-subscription). Ensure these handlers update the system correctly.

trello.name: Prepare Subscription Testing Plan
trello.desc: Owner: Taylor. Deadline: Testing phase in week 3. Prepare a detailed test plan covering both manual and automated tests. The plan should simulate different events like payment failures and cancellations, and cover the whole subscription flow from sign-up to billing to managing the subscription. Share the test plan with Jordan and Alex.

trello.name: Create User Documentation and Support Materials
trello.desc: Owner: Team (Jordan/Taylor). Create clear instructions and a help section or FAQ available for users once the system is live. This should cover common issues and questions about how to manage subscriptions, access invoices, and handle any issues.

trello.name: Document API Endpoints and Webhook Handlers
trello.desc: Owner: Taylor. Document the API endpoints and webhook event handlers to ensure easier maintenance and troubleshooting in the future.

trello.name: Schedule Follow-up Meeting
trello.desc: Owner: Alex. Schedule a follow-up meeting for next week to review progress on the Stripe integration and address any issues or blockers that come up.
